The high scores from the prediction model indicate a strong likelihood of these interactions, suggesting that Dehydrobruceine B may exert its effects through a pathway that involves the modulation of potassium channels. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Dehydrobruceine B and the potassium channel, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated.
